title: Introduce RBAC rollback safety, KMS usage metrics, and residency-decision auditor
author: Aisha Banerjee
release_notes: Adds an RBAC rollback-safety compiler pass (prevents large accidental denies), KMS usage telemetry for billing/audit, and a sampled residency-decision auditor that attaches proof metadata to audit logs. No user-facing API changes.
description: Motivation: A recent internal incident showed a risky pattern where a large RBAC policy rollback (mass deny) could be applied by accident during fast rollouts. At the same time we need better visibility into KMS usage at the operator and service level for billing and compliance, and a compact residency-decision auditor to help debug residency pinning decisions. This PR introduces three coordinated changes: 1) RBAC rollback-safety compiler pass that detects and blocks high-impact policy diffs unless an explicit multi-approver override is present; 2) lightweight KMS usage metrics exporter for the control plane (per-tenant, per-key/provider counters and sampled latencies); 3) residency-decision auditor that samples decision traces, attaches a signed lightweight proof (claim + decision hash) to the audit envelope, and emits an audit event for offline replay.
commit_summary: a1b2c3d: rbac/compiler: add rollback_safety pass that computes impact ratio and requires multi-approver override
b2c3d4e: controlplane/metrics: add kms_usage exporter (kmssvc.kms_requests_total, kmssvc.kms_request_latency_seconds)
c3d4e5f: audit/residency: add decision sampler and proof encoder (compact signed claim)
d4e5f6a: tests: unit + integration tests for rollback safety, metrics labels, and residency proof roundtrip
e5f6a7b: docs: extend RBAC changelog with rollout guidance and add observability page for kms_usage metrics
review_comments: Miguel Ortega (reviewer): Requested a clearer failure mode in the CLI — don't block, but mark the change as "high-impact" and require 2 approvals for automated merges. Also asked for unit tests around empty-policy edge case.

Author (Aisha): Implemented — CLI now annotates high-impact PRs and pipeline will fail automated merge until approvals are present; added unit tests for empty-policy and no-op diffs in rbac/compiler tests.
Samantha Klein (reviewer): Asked to ensure KMS exporter labels include provider and tenant_id and to avoid cardinality explosion. Suggested using an optional dimension set for top-level tenants only.

Author (Aisha): Updated exporter to emit provider and tenant_id as labels only for aggregated metrics; per-key counters are bucketed by key_type (CMK/DEK) to limit cardinality. Added a note in docs about label cardinality and best practices.
Leon Wu (reviewer): Called out that residency proofs need crypto housekeeping; requested a rotation strategy for the proof signer keys and a fallback when signing fails.

Author (Aisha): Added key rotation hooks to proof_signer and an opt-out: when signing fails we still emit an unsigned decision with `proof_present=false` in the audit envelope and surface an internal alert. Tests added to simulate signer failure.
QA (comment): Flaky e2e initially due to test clock drift; fixed by using monotonic timers in tests. CI rerun passed.

merge_outcome_note: Merged after second approval (Miguel, Samantha). Squash-merged with a single commit message summarizing the three features and noting rollout instructions. Backport to release/2024-05-rc queued.
notes_about_deployment: Feature is guarded behind two runtime flags: --rbac-rollback-safety (enabled by default for control plane) and --residency-audit-sampler (default sample rate = 0.01). KMS metrics endpoint is wired into the control-plane metrics stack and is safe for 10k TPS control-plane load due to internal aggregation. Operators should monitor `rbac.rollback_high_impact_detected_total` and `kmssvc.kms_requests_total` when enabling in prod. Backport PR for release branch will flip the rollout-safety to opt-in until ops completes a manual audit run.
testing_and_validation: Unit tests: added 18 new tests covering impact calculation, approvals gating, proof signing and signer-failure fallback. Integration tests: e2e simulating a staged policy rollback with approval flow; metrics smoke test for label cardinality. Load validation: local perf run (control plane) at simulated 5k req/s to validate metrics aggregation. QA notes included in the PR checklist.
